question: Does the exact minimum Bloodfire candidate supply the historically required policy-sensitive, naturally reached and separated inherited Ash pair, with every recorded Leech mediator/read-path contrast source-bound and factually reconciled?
entry: Existing minimum Bloodfire preflight and complete signed arm2 screen pass. Their immutable raw/source evidence is reused, never replayed.
candidate: Reuse only candidate runtime in the completed signed-screen source archive, byte-check every archived source. No content/rule/policy edits. Add read-only observed simulator factory and post-decision clones, not a gameplay controller.
policy_scope: 128 shipping BalancePolicy.sample_range parameter vectors, each aggregated over four fixed seeds; not 512 different policies or a substitute for all competent controllers. No package-preference filter or off-route bans.

qualification.definition: Both vows, first two fixed configurations, one qualification-only seed. Zero qualification rows enter support. Verify full original endpoint equality, exact clone state/events/returns, original state unmodified, intentional intervention only, and all bound script parsers before population.

stages: Complete Ash V5 512 outcome rows. Evaluate once all128 policies and all4seeds are complete.
Only if V5 support passes, complete Ash V0 with the identical fixed policy/seed assignment. No extension or substitute seeds.
support_authority: Inherited post-v38-ash-package-pair-v1 and its unchanged32/32 sensitivity,16 reachability,eight exclusive gates. Cross-active descriptive only. These are necessary support, not new full-package admission standards.

activation.bloodfire: Final deck contains both registered cards; actual legal BloodRite status application and actual legal Leech stack consumption are observed. The unique source is bound by minimum-delta source. Local incremental HP/heal is reported separately, not silently substituted for this inherited definition.
activation.hand: Final deck contains Phantom and Preparation or Surge; a present producer and Phantom are actually played, Phantom emitted damage is positive. This reproduces the historical necessary support definition, not temporal Hand causality.
activation.reachability: Observed true native deck co-ownership plus actual consumer play through untouched starter/reward/shop/event paths. Full native outcome/economy records and command card identities retained.
activation.inactive: Configuration with no registered activation in all four complete runs. Unknown/missing/faulted records are never assigned inactive.

intervention.factorial: At EVERY attempted Leech, clone full native run/combat and shared object identities after policy decision. none/B erase current Bloodfire stock; none/A disable its consumer read path. Apply identical command to each; keep costs, hit/Block/thorns/death, healing, hooks and RNG.
intervention.checks: Every AB matches factual full after-state/events/return; source game unchanged by cloning; every clone initially equals source; only stated stock intervention changes prestate; zero-stock and dormant exact nulls; identical command legality.
intervention.estimands: Target clamped HP removed, native hit amounts including overkill, and actual heal events are separate. Local AB-A-B+none reported. No sum of clones becomes whole-run treatment effect.
intervention.limits: Stock removal is NOT producer-command removal or an adaptively replanned counterfactual policy. This phase does not claim full Hand causal admission, descriptor validation or independent full-package confirmation.

decision.pass: Necessary inherited-pair support in both vows plus source/observer checks. Continue only missing full causal/descriptor/competent-policy and independent-confirmation obligations; no package/P9 admission from this test.
decision.fail: Close this fixed candidate/controller-family support claim; skip V0 when V5 fails. Preserve all rows/negatives, no extra seeds, retune, refit or new sampler rescue in this protocol. Not universal candidate nonviability.
decision.inconclusive: Any incomplete data, wrong source or failed clone/observer binding prevents scientific promotion. Preserve all available bytes and diagnose exact delivery defect under unchanged rules; no fabricated zero.

review: AUTHOR_SELF_REVIEW_NOT_INDEPENDENT. Finite clone checks plus stock/observer qualification are not a universal runtime oracle. Tests reject hidden state changes, incorrect nulls, extra apparent policies, overlap masquerading as separation and overkill counted as HP.
